name: IPP
note: C5 extender unit; IPP and DMAPP interconvert through IPP isomerase.
noteKo: C5 extender unit; IPP and DMAPP interconvert through IPP isomerase.

name: DMAPP
note: C5 allylic starter unit. Prenyltransferases combine DMAPP with IPP to build longer precursors.
noteKo: C5 allylic starter unit. Prenyltransferases combine DMAPP with IPP to build longer precursors.

name: GPP
note: C10 geranyl diphosphate, formed from DMAPP + IPP; a common monoterpene precursor.
noteKo: C10 geranyl diphosphate, formed from DMAPP + IPP; a common monoterpene precursor.

name: FPP
note: C15 farnesyl diphosphate; a common sesquiterpene precursor. Two FPP molecules supply C30 squalene.
noteKo: C15 farnesyl diphosphate; a common sesquiterpene precursor. Two FPP molecules supply C30 squalene.

name: GGPP
note: C20 geranylgeranyl diphosphate supplies many diterpenes. Two GGPP molecules supply C40 phytoene.
noteKo: C20 geranylgeranyl diphosphate supplies many diterpenes. Two GGPP molecules supply C40 phytoene.

name: (+)-CPP
note: The (+)-copalyl diphosphate stereoisomer is shown explicitly. Bare CPP can be a generic literature label; it does not identify absolute stereochemistry. This is the enantiomer of ent-CPP.
noteKo: The (+)-copalyl diphosphate stereoisomer is shown explicitly. Bare CPP can be a generic literature label; it does not identify absolute stereochemistry. This is the enantiomer of ent-CPP.

name: ent-CPP
note: ent-Copalyl diphosphate is a labdane-related class II product. ent-Kaurene synthase converts it to ent-kaurene in gibberellin biosynthesis.
noteKo: ent-Copalyl diphosphate is a labdane-related class II product. ent-Kaurene synthase converts it to ent-kaurene in gibberellin biosynthesis.

name: syn-CPP
note: syn-Copalyl diphosphate is a diastereomer of the (+)/ent pair. Identical formulas do not imply identical stereochemistry or downstream TPS compatibility.
noteKo: syn-Copalyl diphosphate is a diastereomer of the (+)/ent pair. Identical formulas do not imply identical stereochemistry or downstream TPS compatibility.

name: (−)-KPP
note: A stereochemically specified (−)-kolavenyl diphosphate reference: neutral-acid PubChem CID 129626741 (ChEBI:139033). The selected structure retains the chiral core of (−)-kolavenol CID 6442554. CLPP is a broader literature label and is not an unambiguous name for this single stereoisomer.
noteKo: 입체배열이 지정된 (−)-kolavenyl diphosphate의 참고 구조로, 중성 산 형태의 PubChem CID 129626741(ChEBI:139033)이다. 선택한 구조는 (−)-kolavenol CID 6442554와 같은 입체배열의 핵심 골격을 가진다. CLPP는 더 넓은 문헌상 계열명이므로 이 입체이성질체 하나를 명확하게 지칭하는 이름은 아니다.

name: HPP
note: Halimadienyl diphosphate (tuberculosinol diphosphate), a halimane-related class II product. HPP is also used for other halimane diphosphates, so double-bond positions matter. This PubChem record is a trianion.
noteKo: Halimadienyl diphosphate (tuberculosinol diphosphate), a halimane-related class II product. HPP is also used for other halimane diphosphates, so double-bond positions matter. This PubChem record is a trianion.

name: GFPP
note: C25 geranylfarnesyl diphosphate. Addition of one C5 IPP unit to C20 GGPP gives C25, not C30. This requires a prenyltransferase with the appropriate chain-length specificity. GFPP supplies sesterterpene synthesis.
noteKo: C25 geranylfarnesyl diphosphate. Addition of one C5 IPP unit to C20 GGPP gives C25, not C30. This requires a prenyltransferase with the appropriate chain-length specificity. GFPP supplies sesterterpene synthesis.

name: Hexaprenyl diphosphate
note: C30 all-trans-hexaprenyl diphosphate. Its linear chain can be reached by two C5 extensions beyond GGPP, through C25 GFPP, with a suitable medium-chain prenyl diphosphate synthase. This is chemically distinct from C30 squalene, formed by coupling two C15 FPP units; one extra IPP does not make C30 from C20.
noteKo: C30 all-trans-hexaprenyl diphosphate. Its linear chain can be reached by two C5 extensions beyond GGPP, through C25 GFPP, with a suitable medium-chain prenyl diphosphate synthase. This is chemically distinct from C30 squalene, formed by coupling two C15 FPP units; one extra IPP does not make C30 from C20.

name: NNPP
note: Nerylneryl diphosphate: the (Z,Z,Z) C20 geometric isomer used as an alternative substrate in characterised PvCPS1 experiments. It is compared with (E,E,E)-GGPP to explore substrate-folding effects. It is not assigned here as a native Tinospora precursor.
noteKo: Nerylneryl diphosphate는 (Z,Z,Z) C20 기하이성질체입니다. PvCPS1 연구에서 (E,E,E)-GGPP와 비교한 대체 기질이며 기질 배치의 영향을 보여줍니다. Tinospora의 실제 전구체로 지정한 것은 아닙니다.

name: cis-trans-CLPP · relative model
note: A relative-stereochemistry model of cis-trans clerodienyl diphosphate with full C20 diphosphate connectivity. Only cis C5/C10 ring fusion and trans C8/C9 methyl relationships are specified. Independent enhanced OR groups leave absolute and inter-pair stereochemistry unresolved; side-chain C13 E/Z is unassigned. This is a partial molecular model rather than a fully identified natural isolate. See the cited study for characterised CLPP stereoisomers.
noteKo: C20 diphosphate 결합 관계를 표시한 cis-trans clerodienyl diphosphate의 상대입체배열 모형이다. Cis C5/C10 고리 접합과 trans C8/C9 methyl 관계만 지정한다. 독립적인 enhanced OR group을 사용하므로 절대 입체배열과 두 쌍 사이의 관계는 미정이며, 곁사슬 C13 E/Z도 지정하지 않았다. 완전히 동정된 천연 분리물 대신 부분적인 분자 모형이며, 확인된 CLPP 입체이성질체는 인용 문헌을 참고해야 한다.

name: cis-cis-CLPP · relative model
note: A relative-stereochemistry model of cis-cis clerodienyl diphosphate with full C20 diphosphate connectivity. Only cis C5/C10 ring fusion and cis C8/C9 methyl relationships are specified. Independent enhanced OR groups leave absolute and inter-pair stereochemistry unresolved; side-chain C13 E/Z is unassigned. This is a partial molecular model rather than a fully identified natural isolate. See the cited study for characterised CLPP stereoisomers.
noteKo: C20 diphosphate 결합 관계를 표시한 cis-cis clerodienyl diphosphate의 상대입체배열 모형이다. Cis C5/C10 고리 접합과 cis C8/C9 methyl 관계만 지정한다. 독립적인 enhanced OR group을 사용하므로 절대 입체배열과 두 쌍 사이의 관계는 미정이며, 곁사슬 C13 E/Z도 지정하지 않았다. 완전히 동정된 천연 분리물 대신 부분적인 분자 모형이며, 확인된 CLPP 입체이성질체는 인용 문헌을 참고해야 한다.

name: Neryl diphosphate (NPP)
note: A real (2Z) C10 prenyl diphosphate substrate used by selected monoterpene synthases. It is distinct from enzyme-bound linalyl diphosphate in GPP-cyclase mechanisms.
noteKo: 특정 monoterpene synthase가 사용하는 실제 (2Z) C10 prenyl diphosphate 기질이다. GPP 고리화 기전에서 효소에 결합된 linalyl diphosphate와 구분한다.

name: (+)-Bornyl diphosphate
note: A cyclic C10 diphosphate with a bornane core. Bornyl diphosphate synthase uses class I ionization and diphosphate recapture; retained diphosphate does not imply class II chemistry.
noteKo: Bornane 골격을 가진 고리형 C10 diphosphate이다. Synthase는 class I 이온화와 diphosphate 재포획을 사용하며 diphosphate가 남는다고 class II 반응인 것은 아니다.
